sources.title: Millions of people are pretending to be AI chatbots — for fun
sources.snippet: The joy of playing AI chatbot dress-up More than one third of U.S. adults have used ChatGPT, according to a June 2025 Pew Research study. People are not only deploying AI chatbots for everything from planning trips to doing homework assignments — they are also having fun impersonating them.

sources.snippet: Ysobel Sims AI and Environmental Conservation Scientist This site details some of my projects and research in the fields of machine learning, environmental conservation and robotics. sources.title: Exploring GPT-4 for Robotic Agent Strategy with Real-Time State ...
sources.snippet: We explore the use of GPT-4 on a humanoid robot in simulation and the real world as proof of concept of a novel large language model (LLM) driven behaviour method. LLMs have shown the ability to perform various tasks, including robotic agent behaviour.
